signals.text: Bayern monitoring Wirtz - Monday's gossip. Florian Wirtz is being monitored by Bayern Munich, Bournemouth's Brazil forward Rayan could be a Liverpool target next summer and Borussia Dortmund rule out move for Jadon Sancho.
Foden sees red as Mainoo impresses - Manchester derby ratings. How Manchester United and Manchester City players rated in the derby clash at Old Trafford.
Struggling Preston North End sack Heckingbottom. Preston North End sack Paul Heckingbottom after six defeats in seven league games left the Lilywhites second bottom of the Championship.

Getting goal decision so wrong is 'baffling' - Rooney. Match of the Day pundits Wayne Rooney and Danny Murphy finds it "baffling" that Erling Haaland's winning goal in the Manchester derby was not ruled out by VAR, but think Phil Foden's red card was the correct decision.
